abstract: Drafting in the swim leg of mass-start triathlon transfers a hydrodynamic cost advantage to the bike and run, where it surfaces as a change in relative rank. I use cross-stage rank improvement as a reverse proxy for free-riding and study its determinants in a ten-year panel of athlete × event records centred on 2020, when COVID-19 response policies replaced mass starts with individually staggered starts and mechanically curtailed drafting. A compact two-stage contest model, in which drafting enters the bike–run stage as a multiplicative cost shifter, organises the predictions. Identification combines pooled OLS with athlete and event fixed effects and a sharp regression-discontinuity design at the 2019/2020 cut-off. Free-riding was substantial before 2020, fell sharply in 2020 (a local-linear RDD estimate of about −31 rank places; a local-cubic estimate of about −92), and recovered only partially afterwards. The gains are largest for weaker swimmers and deeper drafting positions, the gender gap is modest, and they rise with swim-group size at an estimated log–log elasticity of about 0.43. The 2020 disruption thus acts as a contraction of the feasible set for free-riding, and its recovery is uneven rather than broad-based.
abstract_zh: 在集体出发游泳赛段中跟游所产生的流体力学成本优势会转移至自行车与跑步阶段，并表现为相对排名的变化。本文以跨赛段排名提升作为搭便车行为的反向代理指标，基于以2020年为中心的十年期运动员×赛事面板数据，研究其决定因素——2020年新冠疫情应对政策将集体出发改为间隔出发，从机制上限制了跟游行为。通过构建紧凑的两阶段竞赛模型（将跟游作为乘数型成本转移因子纳入自行车-跑步阶段）来组织预测。识别策略结合了混合OLS回归、运动员与赛事固定效应，以及以2019/2020年为断点的锐化回归断点设计。2020年前搭便车现象显著，2020年急剧下降（局部线性RDD估计值约为-31个排名位次；局部立方估计值约为-92），此后仅部分恢复。游泳能力较弱的运动员和跟游位置更靠后的选手获益最大，性别差异较小，且收益随游泳组规模扩大而增加（估计对数-对数弹性约为0.43）。因此，2020年的冲击相当于收缩了搭便车的可行集，其恢复呈现非均衡特征而非全面复苏。
title: Drafting and Free-Riding in Mass-Start Triathlon: Evidence from a COVID-19 Start-Format Discontinuity

abstract: With the widespread adoption of sugar‐sweetened beverage (SSB) taxes, top‐down facilitation measures—designed to influence consumer tax cognition—have limited impact, even though they are widely promoted as a means of enhancing tax effectiveness. This study introduces a bottom‐up facilitation approach that targets immediate and direct information available to consumers. We examine how these two types of facilitation measures jointly affect tax policy efficacy. Results indicate that top‐down measures, such as public health education campaigns, do not significantly reduce SSB purchases when implemented alone. However, when combined with bottom‐up measures—such as displaying the specific tax amount on product labels—the tax's effectiveness increases substantially. In addition, a difference‐in‐differences style analysis reveals that the combination of top‐down and bottom‐up facilitation measures significantly reduces consumer willingness to purchase SSBs and helps mitigate reactance observed under top‐down‐only conditions, particularly among consumers who are more likely to ignore or discount the top‐down educational information about the SSB tax. These findings provide actionable insights into how the design of public health taxation—such as SSB taxes—can be optimized to strengthen behavioral responses and enhance policy outcomes.
abstract_zh: 随着含糖饮料（SSB）税收政策的广泛实施，旨在影响消费者税收认知的“自上而下”促进措施——尽管被广泛宣传为提升税收有效性的手段——实际效果有限。本研究引入了一种针对消费者即时直接信息的“自下而上”促进方法，考察这两类促进措施如何共同影响税收政策效能。结果表明，单独实施公共卫生教育宣传等自上而下措施时，并未显著减少含糖饮料购买行为。然而，当与在产品标签上显示具体税额等自下而上措施结合使用时，税收有效性大幅提升。此外，基于双重差分法的分析显示，自上而下与自下而上促进措施的组合能显著降低消费者购买含糖饮料的意愿，并有助于缓解仅在自上而下条件下观察到的消费者逆反心理——尤其对更易忽视或低估含糖饮料税自上而下教育信息的消费者群体效果显著。这些发现为优化含糖饮料税等公共卫生税收政策设计、强化行为响应及提升政策成效提供了可操作的见解。
title: Facilitating sugar taxes with top‐down and bottom‐up information: A combined approach for improved tax efficacy
title_zh: 自上而下与自下而上信息促进糖税：提升税收效力的综合方法

abstract: Land fragmentation is widely recognized as a constraint on smallholder agriculture, raising production costs, limiting mechanization, and reducing efficiency. Land consolidation programs have been introduced in many countries to address this problem, yet their economic effects depend not only on plot reconfiguration but also on institutional implementation and land market functioning. This paper examines the impacts of Vietnam's state‐led land consolidation program using six waves of household panel data (2008–2018) from two provinces where consolidation was implemented. Impacts are estimated with two‐way fixed effects and a staggered difference‐in‐differences approach that accounts for heterogeneous adoption timing. The results show that the consolidation program substantially reduced land fragmentation: the number of plots per household fell by roughly three plots, average plot size increased by about 66 percent, and the distance between plots and homesteads declined by approximately 23 percent. At the same time, administrative delays in reissuing land‐use‐right certificates temporarily reduced the share of titled and collateral‐eligible land. While households’ overall access to credit is not adversely affected, land rental markets are significantly disrupted, with both rent‐in and rent‐out declining. Such reductions in land transactions may impede efficient land reallocation and operational scale adjustment, thereby delaying investment and productivity gains from improved land structure. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of institutional implementation and complementary market functioning for realizing the benefits of land consolidation in Vietnam and other smallholder economies.
abstract_zh: 土地细碎化被广泛认为是制约小农农业的瓶颈，它提高了生产成本、限制了机械化进程并降低了生产效率。许多国家推行了土地整合计划以应对这一问题，但其经济效果不仅取决于地块重组，还依赖于制度实施和土地市场运行。本文利用越南两个实施土地整合省份的六轮农户面板数据（2008-2018年），考察了该国政府主导的土地整合计划的影响。采用双向固定效应和考虑异质性采纳时点的交错双重差分法进行效应估计。结果显示：土地整合计划显著降低了土地细碎化程度——每户地块数量减少约3块，平均地块面积增加约66%，地块与宅基地距离缩短约23%。与此同时，重新颁发土地使用权证过程中的行政延迟导致有证土地和可抵押土地比例暂时下降。虽然农户整体信贷获取未受负面影响，但土地租赁市场受到显著干扰，租入和租出行为均出现减少。这种土地交易的缩减可能阻碍土地有效再配置和经营规模调整，从而延缓因土地结构改善带来的投资和生产率提升。总体而言，研究结果凸显了制度实施与配套市场功能对越南及其他小农经济体实现土地整合效益的关键作用。
title: Land Consolidation, Tenure Documentation, and Land Rental Markets: Evidence from rural Vietnam
title_zh: 土地整合、产权登记与土地租赁市场：来自越南农村的证据

abstract: This study reassesses the impact of the historical BSE outbreak on EU diets, showing that consumption patterns shifted persistently even after policy actions eliminated the food safety risk. Utilizing advanced difference‐in‐differences techniques on 1980–2020 data, we demonstrate that while beef consumption exhibited a transient U‐shaped recovery relative to other meats, it declined sharply compared to plant‐based products, with average reductions of 79%, 29%, and 28% for pulses, cereals, and vegetable oils, respectively. This highlights a structural dietary change, overlooked by previous analyses focused on meat substitution. Results are robust to sensitivity analyses. Understanding the primary drivers behind the structural shift in EU consumer diets over recent decades is crucial for future research investigating the reduction in red meat consumption driven by environmental and health concerns in high‐income countries.
abstract_zh: 本研究重新评估了历史上疯牛病疫情对欧盟饮食结构的影响，结果表明即使在政策行动消除食品安全风险后，消费模式仍发生了持续性转变。基于1980-2020年数据，采用先进的双重差分技术，我们发现：牛肉消费相对于其他肉类呈现短暂的U型恢复，但相较于植物性产品则显著下降——豆类、谷物和植物油的消费量平均分别减少79%、29%和28%。这揭示了以往聚焦肉类替代效应的研究所忽视的结构性饮食变迁。敏感性分析证实了结果的稳健性。理解近几十年来欧盟消费者饮食结构变迁的主要驱动力，对于未来研究高收入国家因环境和健康担忧导致红肉消费减少的课题具有关键意义。
title: From Meat to Plant‐Based Products? The Enduring Impact of BSE on Beef Consumption
title_zh: 从肉类到植物基产品？疯牛病对牛肉消费的持久影响

abstract: In real estate markets featuring substantial search friction and strong seller loss aversion, external shocks that shift buyer valuations are largely reflected in liquidity fluctuations, while price adjustments tend to be rigid. This study examines market liquidity shifts following the tightening of South Korean farmland ownership regulations, utilizing the 2021 Farmland Act amendment and nationwide parcel‐level transaction data (2013−2023). We estimate the relationships between land liquidity, policy change, and key macro variables (i.e. interest rates) using a monthly county fixed‐effects model. We find that the amendment is significantly associated with a 10%−11% reduction in nationwide market liquidity, as measured by the turnover rate. This negative relationship is geographically heterogeneous, being more pronounced in rural areas while statistically insignificant in investment‐driven urban areas. Furthermore, our decomposition analysis reveals that the post‐enforcement drop in observed market liquidity is mostly associated with rising interest rates. The role of interest rates is more dominant in urbanized areas than rural ones, reflecting the higher concentration of investment‐driven buyers and substantial capital requirements for land acquisition in these regions. Our findings demonstrate that the market response to ownership regulation is strongly mediated by local market conditions, highlighting the challenges of enforcing stringent policies in areas with high investment potential.
abstract_zh: 在具有显著搜索摩擦和强烈卖方损失厌恶特征的房地产市场中，改变买方估值的外部冲击主要反映在流动性波动上，而价格调整往往呈现刚性。本研究利用2021年《农地法》修正案及2013-2023年全国地块层面交易数据，考察韩国农地所有权监管收紧后的市场流动性变化。我们采用月度县级固定效应模型，估计土地流动性、政策变化与关键宏观变量（如利率）之间的关系。研究发现，该修正案与全国市场流动性（以周转率衡量）显著下降10%-11%相关。这种负向关系存在地理异质性：在农村地区更为显著，而在投资驱动的城市地区统计上不显著。此外，分解分析表明，政策实施后观察到的市场流动性下降主要与利率上升相关。利率在城市化地区的作用比农村地区更为突出，这反映了这些地区投资驱动型买家的高度集中以及土地收购所需的大量资本。我们的研究结果表明，市场对所有权监管的反应受到当地市场条件的强烈调节，凸显了在高投资潜力地区实施严格政策的挑战。
title: Farmland Liquidity Under a Tightened Ownership Regime: Urban–Rural Heterogeneity in South Korea
title_zh: 收紧所有权制度下的农地流动性：韩国的城乡异质性

abstract: Activity shortfalls are more costly than strong activity. I consider optimal monetary policy under discretion with an asymmetric (shortfalls) loss function in a natural rate model. The optimal monetary policy exacerbates shortfalls, owing to the adjustment of expectations implied by the natural rate hypothesis, and leads to an inflationary bias. Mandating a central bank objective with greater symmetry lowers activity shortfalls and inflation bias. The model also implies that an optimal monetary policy does not accommodate fluctuations from aggregate demand shocks. The analysis implies that monetary accommodation of strong economic activity requires justifications other than asymmetric costs of shortfalls.
abstract_zh: 活动缺口比强劲活动代价更高。本文在自然率模型下，考虑具有非对称（缺口）损失函数的相机抉择最优货币政策。由于自然率假说所隐含的预期调整，最优货币政策会加剧活动缺口，并导致通胀偏差。设定更具对称性的央行目标可降低活动缺口与通胀偏差。该模型还表明，最优货币政策不会对总需求冲击引发的波动进行调节。分析表明，对强劲经济活动的货币调节需要以缺口非对称成本之外的理由作为依据。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Monetary Policy, Employment Shortfalls, and the Natural Rate Hypothesis
title_zh: 货币政策、就业缺口与自然率假说

abstract: This article uses the township‐level data on welfare expenditure and provision gathered by parish officers in England and Wales at three points between 1776 and 1815 to illuminate regional and local differences during the period. These data have been linked to geographic information system (GIS) mapping systems, facilitating the mapping of parish/township level welfare data across a wide range of variables. Appropriate linkage to the 1801 and 1811 census data and the 1815 income tax property valuations also permits new village‐level estimates of the prevalence, affordability, and typology of welfare provision. The results challenge current hypotheses about regional differences in how the Poor Law was administered.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1776年至1815年间英格兰与威尔士教区官员收集的三个时间点的乡镇级福利支出与供给数据，揭示该时期区域与地方差异。这些数据已与地理信息系统（GIS）制图系统关联，从而能够基于广泛变量绘制教区/乡镇级福利数据地图。通过将数据与1801年及1811年人口普查数据、1815年所得税财产估值进行适当关联，还可对福利供给的普及程度、可负担性及类型进行新的村级估算。研究结果对当前关于济贫法实施区域差异的假说提出了挑战。
title: Regional and local divergence in welfare provision in England and Wales, 1776–1815
title_zh: 1776-1815年英格兰与威尔士福利供给的区域与地方分化

abstract: Voluntary agricultural land retirement programs are widely recognized for their environmental benefits, yet their economic effects, particularly on labor markets and land tenure, remain less understood. This paper examines the short‐ and long‐term impacts of the first large‐scale US land retirement initiative, the historical Conservation Reserve Program, introduced under the 1956 Set‐Aside Act. Between 1957 and 1960, the program enrolled more than 30 million acres under 3‐, 5‐, or 10‐year contracts, which then expired gradually through 1970. Using a newly digitized Conservation Reserve Program enrollment database linked to agricultural census data from the 1950s through the 1970s, we find that counties with medium and high enrollment intensity experienced statistically significant declines in tenant‐cultivated land relative to low‐enrollment counties during the program's active years. In medium‐enrollment counties, tenant‐operated land declined by roughly 0.6 percentage points, while high‐enrollment counties experienced declines of approximately 1.6 percentage points nationally. The proportion of tenant farm operators also fell in both medium‐ and high‐enrollment counties. These effects were larger and more persistent in the South, especially in counties with higher shares of nonwhite farm operators and sharecropping.
abstract_zh: 自愿性农业土地休耕项目因其环境效益而广受认可，但其经济影响——特别是对劳动力市场和土地保有权的影响——仍鲜为人知。本文考察了美国首个大规模土地休耕计划——1956年《预留法案》下设立的历史性保护储备计划——的短期与长期影响。1957年至1960年间，该计划以3年、5年或10年合同形式纳入了超过3000万英亩土地，这些合同随后于1970年前逐步到期。通过将新数字化的保护储备计划登记数据库与20世纪50年代至70年代的农业普查数据相关联，我们发现：在项目活跃期，中等和高强度登记县相对于低登记县，租佃耕地面积出现了统计上显著的下降。在全国范围内，中等登记县的租佃经营土地面积下降约0.6个百分点，而高登记县则下降约1.6个百分点。中等和高登记县的租佃农场经营者比例也同步下降。这些效应在南方地区更为显著且持久，尤其在非白人农场经营者及分成制佃农比例较高的县份表现突出。
title: Consequences of land retirement policies on agricultural labor and land tenure: Evidence from the historical Conservation Reserve Program in the United States
title_zh: 土地休耕政策对农业劳动力和土地保有权的影响：来自美国历史性保护储备计划的证据

abstract: We develop a structural framework to identify the sources of cross‐state heterogeneity in response to U.S. tariff changes. A unilateral 25‐percentage‐point U.S. tariff increase across sectors induces consumption changes ranging from −0.8% in Oregon to 2.3% in Montana. This variation stems from the interaction between states' internal comparative advantage and the nation's external comparative advantage. Factor mobility lowers aggregate consumption and reshapes the cross‐state impacts by shifting resources toward more distorted states and sectors. Consequently, preferred tariff changes vary systematically across states, necessitating transfers to align regional policy incentives. Foreign retaliation reduces aggregate gains while perpetuating cross‐state variation.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个结构性框架，用以识别美国关税变化中各州异质性反应的来源。若美国对各行业统一加征25个百分点的关税，各州消费变化幅度从俄勒冈州的-0.8%到蒙大拿州的2.3%不等。这种差异源于各州内部比较优势与国家外部比较优势之间的相互作用。要素流动性通过将资源向扭曲程度更高的州和行业转移，降低了总体消费水平并重塑了跨州影响。因此，各州偏好的关税变化呈现系统性差异，需要通过转移支付来协调区域政策激励。外国报复性措施在减少总体收益的同时，进一步加剧了跨州差异。
title: What Determines State Heterogeneity in Response to U.S. Tariff Changes?
title_zh: 美国关税变化下各州异质性反应的决定因素是什么？

title: The speculation trap and the distress push: Divergent pathways of peri-urban agriculture in Tanzania
title_zh: 投机陷阱与困境推动：坦桑尼亚城郊农业的分化路径

title_zh: 市场中的谋杀

abstract: Political coercion directed against non-state moralities can serve as a tool for generating legitimacy. Does the efficacy of political coercion in producing legitimacy vary with its intensity? Using Freedom House, V-Dem, and Polity5 indices as proxies for coercive intensity, together with data on regime legitimacy and survival, we find that a mid-level range of coercion is ineffective in generating legitimacy. Relatively few regimes operate in this intermediate zone, and those that do exhibit lower legitimacy and higher instability risks. In contrast, shifts away from this suboptimal range-toward either higher or lower coercion levels-correlate significantly with gains in legitimacy. Time-series analysis of authoritarian regimes reveals a recurring pattern: gradual reductions in coercion that drift into this inefficient mid-range, followed by sharp increases. This dynamic suggests that coercion carries substantial exogenous costs such as economic and reputational costs and that delayed feedback on its legitimacy effects produces overshooting. Drawing on historical cases such as the USSR, we argue that moderate coercion proves inefficient due to an intrinsic negative reaction to coercion, or coercion resentment.
abstract_zh: 针对非国家道德的政治强制可成为合法性生成的工具。政治强制在产生合法性方面的效力是否会随其强度变化？通过使用自由之家、V-Dem和Polity5指数作为强制强度的代理变量，结合政权合法性与存续数据，我们发现中等强度的强制区间无法有效生成合法性。相对较少的政权处于这一中间地带，而处于该区间的政权表现出较低的合法性和较高的不稳定风险。相反，偏离这一次优区间——无论是向更高还是更低强制水平移动——与合法性提升显著相关。对威权政权的时间序列分析揭示了一种反复出现的模式：逐步降低强制力度会滑入这一低效的中间区间，随后出现急剧的强制升级。这一动态表明，强制会带来显著的外生成本（如经济成本和声誉成本），而对其合法性效应的延迟反馈会导致过度调整。借鉴苏联等历史案例，我们认为，由于强制会引发内在的负面反应（即强制怨恨），温和的强制被证明是低效的。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The inefficiency of moderate political coercion: a cross-country comparison of coercion intensity, state legitimacy, and regime stability
title_zh: 温和政治胁迫的低效性：胁迫强度、国家合法性与政权稳定性的跨国比较

abstract: Milton Friedman, in the 1960s, was convinced that John Cowperthwaite, the British official overseeing Hong Kong’s economic policy, was conducting the most radical experiment in economic history. A staunch classical liberal within the British civil service, Cowperthwaite aggressively resisted government intervention, believing that free markets fueled growth. His influence was amplified by British domestic politics and the nature of colonial rule, making him a uniquely powerful figure. In this paper, we use the Synthetic Control Method (SCM) and Synthetic Difference-in-Differences (SDID) to assess whether Cowperthwaite truly constrained government expansion and whether his policies drove economic growth. In other words, we test whether Friedman overstated Cowperthwaite’s impact. We find strong evidence that Cowperthwaite limited government growth but had no visible effect on economic growth. We link these results to Hong Kong’s land policies, their impact on government size metrics, and more even-handed assessments of Cowperthwaite’s policy decisions.
abstract_zh: 20世纪60年代，米尔顿·弗里德曼确信，负责香港经济政策的英国官员约翰·考珀斯韦特正在实施经济史上最激进的实验。作为英国文官体系中坚定的古典自由主义者，考珀斯韦特强烈抵制政府干预，坚信自由市场能推动增长。英国国内政治与殖民统治的特性放大了他的影响力，使其成为一位拥有独特权力的关键人物。本文采用合成控制法（SCM）与合成双重差分法（SDID），评估考珀斯韦特是否真正限制了政府扩张，以及他的政策是否推动了经济增长。换言之，我们检验弗里德曼是否夸大了考珀斯韦特的影响。研究发现，考珀斯韦特确实限制了政府规模增长，但对经济增长并无显著影响。我们将这些结果与香港的土地政策、其对政府规模指标的影响，以及对考珀斯韦特政策决策更为公允的评价联系起来。

abstract: This study examines the causal effects of anti-corruption reforms on wealth concentration. Using data from the World Inequality Database, the World Governance Indicators, and V-Dem across more than 150 countries, I employ a staggered difference-in-differences approach to identify the impact of sustained drops in measured corruption on wealth distribution. Sustained anti-corruption reforms significantly reduce wealth concentration at the top while increasing shares at the bottom of the distribution. Ten years after implementation, the top 1% wealth share falls by approximately 2 percentage points and the top 10% share by 1.5 percentage points, while the bottom 50% share rises by 0.4 percentage points and the bottom 20% share by 0.15 percentage points. These effects emerge gradually, becoming statistically significant within four years of reforms and persisting throughout the observation period. The results are robust across alternative estimators, alternative corruption indicators, and specifications that control for lagged dependent variables, national income, the top 1% income share, political violence, and inflation. A synthetic control analysis of Georgia illustrates how reforms disrupt elite patronage networks, while the subsequent policy reversal caused distributional gains to stagnate. The findings extend the political economy literature by showing that elite-disrupting mechanisms dominate offsetting concerns about informal redistribution and that reforms reshape wealth distribution through expanded access to financial services and property rights rather than through direct fiscal transfers.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了反腐败改革对财富集中的因果效应。基于来自世界不平等数据库、世界治理指标及V-Dem项目覆盖150多个国家的数据，我采用交错双重差分法识别腐败程度持续下降对财富分配的影响。持续的反腐败改革显著降低了顶层财富集中度，同时提高了底层群体的财富占比。改革实施十年后，顶层1%人群的财富份额下降约2个百分点，顶层10%人群下降1.5个百分点，而底层50%人群的财富份额上升0.4个百分点，底层20%人群上升0.15个百分点。这些效应逐步显现，在改革实施四年内达到统计显著性，并在整个观测期内持续存在。该结果在替代估计量、替代腐败指标以及控制滞后因变量、国民收入、顶层1%收入份额、政治暴力与通货膨胀的模型设定中均保持稳健。对格鲁吉亚的综合控制分析表明，改革如何瓦解精英庇护网络，而随后的政策逆转导致分配收益停滞。本研究拓展了政治经济学文献，揭示精英瓦解机制主导了对非正式再分配问题的抵消性担忧，且改革通过扩大金融服务与产权获取渠道（而非直接财政转移）重塑财富分配格局。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Political power and wealth distribution: how anti-corruption reforms reshape inequality
title_zh: 政治权力与财富分配：反腐败改革如何重塑不平等

abstract: I study the economic consequences of cultural diversity within political organizations. Using manually collected data on 25,568 members of county-level standing committees of the Chinese Communist Party and the Chinese Industrial Enterprise Database from 1998 to 2013, I find that cultural diversity in county standing committees significantly reduces industrial output. I further identify potential mechanisms: greater committee diversity is associated with lower government and capital construction spending, slower and weaker responses to public appeals, and lower labor and capital inputs as well as enterprise investment. Moreover, counties with more culturally diverse standing committees exhibit lower nighttime light intensity and reduced per capita GDP. Overall, these results highlight a potential limitation of China’s current political organizational structure and institutional arrangements.
abstract_zh: 我研究了政治组织内部文化多样性的经济后果。基于手动收集的1998年至2013年间中国共产党县级常务委员会25568名成员数据及中国工业企业数据库，发现县级常委会的文化多样性显著降低了工业产出。进一步识别出潜在机制：委员会多样性程度越高，政府与基建支出越低，对公众诉求的响应速度与力度越弱，劳动与资本投入及企业投资也相应减少。此外，文化多样性更高的县级常委会所在地区，夜间灯光强度与人均GDP均有所下降。总体而言，这些结果揭示了中国现行政治组织结构与制度安排可能存在的局限性。

abstract: This paper investigates why Imperial Japan’s promising Taishō-era democracy (1905–32) experienced a gradual descent into militarism that culminated in the collapse of party government and the effective subordination of civilian authority to the military by the late 1930s. Building on North et al.’s (2009) framework, I argue that this democratic reversal was driven by a failure to consolidate civilian control over the instruments of violence. Facing the existential threat of Russian expansion, civilian elites made a deliberate decision to empower the military at a moment when civilian institutional control over the armed forces was weak and the military technology being adopted concentrated coercive power in a professional officer corps insulated from civilian oversight. This combination produced a substantial probability of eventual military takeover, which was realized over the following three decades as each remaining instrument of civilian authority was tested and broken in turn. This trajectory is contrasted with that of Britain, where civilian institutional control over the military had been consolidated two centuries before industrial warfare arrived. Comparable military technologies were later absorbed there into an existing civilian chain of command and kept under civilian direction. I identify a distinct pathway of democratic backsliding and demonstrate that the strength of civilian institutional control and the character of available military technology at the moment of military empowerment are critical determinants of whether democracy endures.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨为何日本帝国颇具前景的大正时代民主（1905–1932年）逐渐滑向军国主义，最终导致政党政府崩溃，并在1930年代末期使文官权力实质上从属于军方。基于诺斯等人（2009年）的分析框架，本文认为，这一民主倒退的根源在于未能巩固文官对暴力工具的控制。面对俄国扩张的生存威胁，文官精英在文官对军队的制度性控制薄弱、且所采用的军事技术将强制力集中于不受文官监督的职业军官团之际，刻意做出了强化军方的决策。这种组合导致军方最终接管政权的概率显著上升，并在随后的三十年间逐一检验并瓦解了剩余的文官权威工具。本文将此路径与英国进行对比——英国在工业战争到来前两个世纪便已巩固了文官对军队的制度性控制。后来引入的同类军事技术被纳入既有文官指挥体系，并始终处于文官主导之下。本文识别出一条独特的民主倒退路径，并证明：在军事权力被赋予的时刻，文官制度性控制的强度与可用军事技术的特性，是决定民主能否存续的关键因素。

abstract: Adam Smith’s account of medieval towns in Book III of The Wealth of Nations remains one of the most influential analyses of how commerce transformed feudal Europe. This paper formalizes Smith’s argument as a game between kings, lords, and towns. The king-town alliance emphasized by Adam Smith emerges when towns are wealthy enough to offer fiscal and military support but lords remain a serious threat. However, when kings become excessively predatory, towns may ally with lords (as in the Magna Carta crisis); when towns are too weak to offer substantial support, kings ally with lords instead (as in Eastern Europe). A dynamic extension shows that the king-town equilibrium is self-undermining: commercial growth erodes lordly military power through Smith’s “diamond buckles” mechanism, eventually enabling royal absolutism. In contrast, the king-lords equilibrium is self-reinforcing, suppressing urban development and preserving feudal institutions. The framework highlights how small differences in initial urban development could generate dramatically different long-run trajectories and illuminates both the brilliance and the limitations of Smith’s conjectural history.
abstract_zh: 亚当·斯密在《国富论》第三卷中对中世纪城镇的论述，至今仍是分析商业如何改变封建欧洲最具影响力的理论之一。本文将斯密的论点形式化为国王、领主与城镇之间的博弈模型。当城镇足够富裕，能够提供财政与军事支持，而领主仍构成严重威胁时，斯密所强调的国王-城镇联盟便会形成。然而，当国王变得过度掠夺性时，城镇可能与领主结盟（如《大宪章》危机时期）；当城镇过于弱小、无法提供实质性支持时，国王则转而与领主结盟（如东欧地区）。动态扩展模型表明，国王-城镇均衡具有自我削弱性：商业增长通过斯密的“钻石扣带”机制侵蚀领主的军事力量，最终促成君主专制。相反，国王-领主均衡具有自我强化性，抑制城市发展并维系封建制度。该框架揭示了初始城市发展的微小差异如何导致截然不同的长期演化路径，并阐明了斯密推测性历史理论的洞见与局限。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Adam Smith and the role of the towns in feudal Europe
title_zh: 亚当·斯密与封建欧洲城镇的角色

abstract: Liberal democracies increasingly curtail civil liberties in response to cultural tensions. I show that such repression can be conceived as a Pigouvian political externality: governments enjoy immediate political benefits from reduced social tension but systematically undervalue long-run costs of institutional erosion. The externality arises because finite tenure and reduced post-tenure valuation make politicians discount institutional quality more steeply than society. I formalize this mechanism in a dynamic linear-quadratic model in which repression lowers visible tension today while degrading future institutional quality, and I derive a closed-form “social cost of repression,” analogous to the social cost of carbon in environmental economics. Pigouvian logic, typically used to diagnose market failure, is here applied to a government failure in democratic self-regulation. I then characterize a class of market-based instruments—sovereign “democracy covenant” bonds, whose coupon rates rise automatically when civil-liberties indices deteriorate—that embed the shadow cost of repression into borrowing costs and thereby better align short-run political incentives with long-run democratic resilience.
abstract_zh: 自由民主政体在应对文化紧张局势时，日益限制公民自由。本文论证此类压制可被理解为一种庇古式政治外部性：政府从社会紧张局势缓解中即时获得政治收益，却系统性低估制度侵蚀的长期成本。这种外部性源于有限任期与离任后价值折损，导致政治家对制度质量的折现率高于社会整体。本文通过动态线性二次模型形式化该机制——压制行为在降低当前显性紧张的同时，持续削弱未来制度质量，并推导出类似环境经济学中"碳社会成本"的"压制社会成本"闭合解。通常用于诊断市场失灵的庇古逻辑，在此被应用于民主自我规制中的政府失灵。进而，本文刻画了一类市场型工具——主权"民主契约"债券，其票面利率随公民自由指数恶化自动攀升——通过将压制的影子成本内化至借贷成本，使短期政治激励与长期民主韧性实现更优校准。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Democratic backsliding as a Pigouvian political externality
title_zh: 民主倒退作为庇古式政治外部性

abstract: This study examines an under-explored implication of population ageing: its relationship with environmental outcomes at the country level and environmental attitudes at the individual level. The analysis introduces a novel classification of environmental outcomes, distinguishing between action-requiring and nature-concerning dimensions based on the degree of civic engagement necessary for their realisation. Using panel data from a broad set of countries over the period 1995–2018, population ageing is shown to be associated with improvements in environmental outcomes that require limited civic engagement, while no systematic relationship is observed for outcomes that rely on active public participation. Complementary evidence from individual-level survey data for 2005–2016 indicates that ageing societies exhibit lower levels of environmental engagement, without a corresponding decline in underlying environmental concern. The findings contribute to the literature on demographic change and environmental performance by highlighting the role of civic engagement as a mediating mechanism and suggest that ageing societies may face specific challenges in sustaining participatory forms of environmental action.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了人口老龄化一个尚未充分挖掘的影响：其在国家层面与环境结果、个体层面与环境态度之间的关系。分析引入了一种新的环境结果分类方法，根据实现这些结果所需的公民参与程度，将其区分为“需要行动型”和“关注自然型”两个维度。利用1995–2018年间多个国家的面板数据，研究发现人口老龄化与那些需要有限公民参与的环境结果的改善相关，而对于依赖公众积极参与的环境结果，则未观察到系统性关联。基于2005–2016年个体层面调查数据的补充证据表明，老龄化社会中的环境参与水平较低，但潜在的环境关注并未相应下降。这些发现通过强调公民参与作为中介机制的作用，为人口变化与环境绩效的相关文献做出了贡献，并表明老龄化社会在维持参与式环境行动方面可能面临特定挑战。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Population Ageing and the Environment: A Comparative Study of Nature-Concerning and Action-Requiring Outcomes
title_zh: 人口老龄化与环境：自然关注型与行动需求型结果的比较研究

abstract: We examine the economic impact of regulating new genomic techniques on investment decisions in the EU. Using a real options model, we compare five major regulatory options (nine including sub-options) with the status quo and analyse their effects on plant breeders’ investments. Using the current authorization process for genetically modified organisms for NGTs presents a high investment barrier for companies. The findings indicate that all alternative five options offer opportunities to reduce investment hurdles, depending on the design of the authorization process. Our model and its calibration serve as an example for further advancing the application of real options for regulatory policy analysis.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了欧盟对新基因组技术进行监管对投资决策的经济影响。通过使用实物期权模型，我们比较了五种主要监管方案（含子方案共九种）与现状的差异，并分析了它们对植物育种者投资的影响。将当前转基因生物授权流程应用于新基因组技术，对企业构成了较高的投资门槛。研究结果表明，所有五种替代方案均提供了降低投资障碍的机会，具体效果取决于授权流程的设计。我们的模型及其校准为推进实物期权在监管政策分析中的应用提供了范例。
title: Comparing the effects of regulating new genomic techniques on investment decisions in the European Union
title_zh: 比较欧盟监管新基因组技术对投资决策的影响

abstract: We experimentally investigate preferences for clumping-versus-separating information in the gain and the loss domains, and also preferences for timing. Our design is motivated by the idea that information preferences may depend on reference points. Subjects participate in two monetary lotteries and choose how to receive the outcome information. For half of the subjects, the lotteries are framed as two gain lotteries; for the other half, as two loss lotteries. Based on Thaler (1985) one can expect that people want to learn the outcomes of the gain lotteries separately and the outcomes of the loss lotteries clumped together (cf. hedonic editing hypothesis). On the other hand, a different reference dependent model by Koszegi and Rabin (2009) relies on expectations-based reference points, and predicts that subjects should prefer clumped information irrespective of the frame. The results of our experiment show a preference for separating information about gains, and no preference for clumping or separating information about losses. Regarding timing, we find a weak overall preference for receiving information sooner. These findings provide new insights into information preferences. We conclude by discussing policy implications, as well as our additional contributions to related literature.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究了人们在收益域和损失域中对信息聚合与分离的偏好，以及对信息获取时机的偏好。实验设计基于信息偏好可能依赖于参照点的理论假设。受试者参与两项货币抽奖，并选择如何接收结果信息。其中一半受试者的抽奖被设定为两项收益抽奖，另一半则为两项损失抽奖。根据Thaler（1985）的理论，人们可能倾向于分别了解收益抽奖的结果，而将损失抽奖的结果合并了解（参见享乐编辑假说）。另一方面，Koszegi和Rabin（2009）提出的基于期望参照点的不同参照依赖模型则预测，无论抽奖框架如何，受试者都应偏好信息聚合。实验结果显示，受试者偏好将收益信息分离呈现，而对损失信息则未表现出聚合或分离的明确偏好。在时机方面，我们发现受试者整体上微弱偏好尽早获取信息。这些发现为信息偏好研究提供了新见解。最后，我们讨论了政策含义及对相关文献的额外贡献。
title: Information preferences, reference points and hedonic editing: experimental evidence
title_zh: 信息偏好、参照点与享乐编辑：实验证据

title: Estimation and inference in boundary discontinuity designs: Distance-based methods

abstract: During the 2020–2021 “AAPI Hate,” mutual funds led by female managers perceived as East Asian underperformed relative to other female managers. This effect is stronger in states with higher anti-Asian animus, among more actively managed funds, and when these managers hold sole or senior roles. Factors concurrent with COVID-19, including childcare challenges, concerns for overseas families, marketplace and workplace discrimination, and exposure to the Chinese economy, cannot explain the effect. Underperformance is traceable to poor stock picking due to impairments in generating private information. Racial-ethnic animosity, even outside workplace or marketplace, hinders productivity and decision-making in high-skill professions.
abstract_zh: 在2020-2021年“亚裔美国人仇恨事件”期间，由被视为东亚裔的女性基金经理管理的共同基金，其表现逊于其他女性基金经理。这一效应在反亚裔情绪更强烈的州、主动管理程度更高的基金中更为显著，且当这些基金经理担任唯一或高级管理职务时尤为突出。与新冠疫情同步发生的因素，包括育儿挑战、对海外家人的担忧、职场与市场歧视以及中国经济敞口，均无法解释该效应。业绩不佳可追溯至因私有信息生成能力受损导致的选股失误。种族-民族敌意，即便发生在职场或市场之外，也会阻碍高技能职业的生产力与决策能力。

abstract: Berge equilibrium offers an alternative to Nash equilibrium in game theory, emphasizing cooperative stability rather than individual optimization. Despite recent interest, a systematic study of Berge equilibria in finite normal form games is still lacking, with fundamental questions like existence remaining open. This paper characterizes Berge equilibria through a polynomial system of equations, enabling computational algebra and algebraic geometry methods to analyze them. Algorithms based on Gröbner bases determine the existence and computation of Berge equilibria. Furthermore, we show that the set of games admitting completely mixed Berge equilibria is contained within a determinantal variety, whose dimension we explicitly bound from above.
abstract_zh: 伯格均衡为博弈论中的纳什均衡提供了一种替代方案，强调合作稳定性而非个体最优化。尽管近期研究兴趣渐增，但有限正规型博弈中伯格均衡的系统性研究仍显不足，诸如存在性等基本问题尚未解决。本文通过多项式方程组刻画伯格均衡，从而能够运用计算代数和代数几何方法对其进行分析。基于格罗布纳基的算法可判定伯格均衡的存在性并实现其计算。此外，我们证明存在完全混合伯格均衡的博弈集合包含于某一行列式簇中，并给出了该簇维数的显式上界。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Berge equilibria – an algebraic approach
